answer: Sybils monetize parallel speed, so tax the one input a farm cannot rent: sequential time. Make each new key publicly compute a verifiable delay function before it can earn - T steps no cluster shortens, one T per identity. Growing a clone nebula gets expensive and bulk registration is no haven; a key becomes a vertex of the trust graph only after its proof lands, so mass-created accounts cannot act while a vote window is open. The speed sybils sell is exactly what the delay removes.
